fixes.H1_lease_tri_state: RuntimeJournal.lease_state() -> current|revoked|unknown (unknown ONLY on sqlite3.Error; 2s busy-timeout on the lease read path); watchdog and all broker-path lease gates kill only on 'revoked' (lease/lease_generation); 'unknown' retries with bounded backoff to a 2s monotonic deadline then kills with DISTINCT lease/lease_unreadable
fixes.H2_H3_single_deadline_owner: FactoryRuntime(clock=...) injected monotonic clock shared by AttemptGuard and watchdog; AttemptGuard owns started_at/deadline properties; watchdog takes a plain-float deadline snapshot AFTER guard.start() and never blocks on the guard's lock; watchdog skips wall-clock enforcement once the process exited or exchange_completing is set; PR #96 started_persisted gating preserved (lease polling deferred until durable start acknowledgement; resource enforcement stays live)
fixes.M6_no_wait_under_kill_lock: ProcessControl.kill (residual/factory/termination_provenance.py, PR #96 component) sets reason + SIGKILL under the state lock and reaps OUTSIDE it; reap TimeoutExpired -> typed reap_timed_out event (+ reap_timeout reason if no primary reason exists); no exception escapes the watchdog thread
fixes.H4_M5_typed_timeout: Extends the M4 exit-code convention: exit 125 + M4SANDBOX-ERROR: = ERROR and candidate exit codes = FAIL unchanged; NEW parent-side wall-clock timeout -> status 'timeout', deterministic returncode 124 (SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_EXIT), timed_out: true on IsolatedResult and on VerificationResult; fixture lane types timeout as 'timeout'; runtime._exchange wait(timeout) TimeoutExpired -> guard.fail('resource','drain_timeout'); subprocess_backend uniform timeout_seconds + LAUNCHER_ALLOWANCE_S (5s) in both paths; SandboxResult.enforcement (kernel/best_effort); bwrap passes kernel
fixes.M8_margins_only: test_factory_runtime.wait_active 5s -> 15s condition-based; test_control_integrity deadline test budget 50ms / sleep 200ms, asserts ordering (calls==1, ABORTED) not wall ratio
fixes.M9_typed_git_timeouts: runtime_workspace.git raises typed GitOperationTimeout (WorkerContractError subclass); m4_integrator git ops inherit it; m4_git_evidence UNKNOWN/ERROR conventions untouched
fixes.cancel_race_fix: cancel() returns True only when the terminal state is CANCELLED and the recorded primary reason is its own operator_cancel; a published CANDIDATE still returns False; covers the kill-before-revote race where the run thread finishes CANCELLED first
